knowledge:
- key_parameters: abatch=An AffyBatch object containing probe-level data passed to pvacFilter ;; cutoff=The PVAC score threshold (default is the 99th percentile of the "Absent" null set, capped at a maximum of 0.5)
- alternatives: Other gene filtering methods such as variance-based or intensity-based independent filtering (e.g., genefilter package). PVAC is preferred specifically for Affymetrix arrays where probe-level correlation within a probeset can be leveraged.
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing Affymetrix microarray gene expression data with at least 6 samples, where probe-level data (CEL files) is available.
- pitfalls: Outlier samples must be removed before running the filtering. The method requires at least 6 samples to perform effective PCA. The input to pvacFilter must be probe-level data (AffyBatch), not summarized expression data.

workflows.name: pvac_microarray_filtering
workflows.intent: Perform PCA-based gene filtering on Affymetrix microarray data to remove non-informative probesets before differential expression testing.
input: celfiles (directory containing raw Affymetrix CEL files)
workflows.stages: 1. Read raw CEL files into an AffyBatch object ;; 2. Summarize probe-level data to probeset-level expression using RMA ;; 3. Calculate PVAC scores and identify passing probesets ;; 4. Subset the summarized ExpressionSet to keep only the filtered probesets
workflows.code:
library(affy)
library(pvac)
library(ALLMLL)
data(MLL.A)
myeset <- rma(MLL.A)
ft <- pvacFilter(MLL.A)
myeset.filtered <- myeset[ft$aset,]
plot(density(ft$pvac[ft$nullset]),xlab="PVAC score",main="",
          col="gray",cex.lab=0.5,xlim=c(0,1))
lines(density(ft$pvac),col=1)
abline(v=ft$cutoff,lty=2,col="gray")
